title: vrm-author-cli acceptance pack
description: An executable acceptance pack for one catalog operation. Packs are frozen by packHash (sha256 of the canonical JSON: sort_keys=true, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii=true, with packHash set to the empty string) and run by the runner declared in `runner`. Paths are relative to the repository root unless a fixture names a `pathEnv` directory.

operation.description: Catalog operation name as listed in commands.md, e.g. `style lint`.

requestSchemaHash.description: sha256 of the operation's registered request schema; empty until the schema registry exists (Stage A).

reviewer.description: Must be a different model family (or a human) than the author. Empty provider/family/version means the review is pending.

reviewReceipt.description: Empty until the independent reviewer signs; the receipt is recorded against packHash.

path.description: Relative to the `pathEnv` directory when set, otherwise to the repository root. Synthetic fixtures use `synthetic:<description>`.

pathEnv.description: Environment variable naming the directory that holds gitignored fixtures; `--fixtures DIR` overrides it, and the repository root is the fallback.

sha256.description: Required unless `synthetic` is true; the runner refuses a file whose bytes differ.

synthetic.description: swift-test packs only: the fixture is built in-process by the suite, so there are no bytes to pin; `sha256` is omitted and the fixture is graded from the suite's results.

expected.description: Per-assertion expected values keyed by assertion id; a null value skips that assertion for this fixture. Keys must name declared assertions.

entryPoint.description: python: script path relative to the repository root; swift-test: the test suite name passed to `swift test --filter`.

profile.description: python style-lint packs: the profile passed as `--profile`, relative to the repository root. Must also appear in oracleHashes.

oracleHashes.description: Repository-relative path -> sha256 of every file the oracle's verdict depends on. The runner refuses to run when the working tree differs.

target.description: report-field: dotted path into the oracle's JSON report; exit-code / error-class: `process`.

expected.description: Default expected value for every fixture; fixtures[].expected[id] overrides it, null skips.

expectedClassification.description: Every mutant must be rejected. What counts as rejection is transform-specific: `style-mutation:*` must flip each rule in expectFlip relative to the unmutated baseline; `report-fabricated` must be refused by the runner's report-acceptance path; `metadata-noop` must be refused as the pinned fixture (sha256 integrity) while its grade stays identical to the baseline (a grade change breaks the control and fails the pack); `swift-test` names the XCTest method that injects the mutant, which must be executed by the suite and pass. A mutant whose run is indistinguishable from the baseline is a failure of the pack, not a pass.

test.description: swift-test: XCTest method in the runner's suite that injects this mutant and must be executed and pass.

suite.description: swift-test: XCTest suite holding `test` when it is not the runner's entryPoint suite; the runner adds it as a further `--filter`.

fixture.description: Fixture id the transform is applied to (metadata-noop, style-mutation:*).

field.description: metadata-noop: dotted path into the glTF JSON chunk to overwrite.

materialNameContains.description: style-mutation:mtoon: substrings; any match selects the material.

changes.description: style-mutation:mtoon: keys merged into VRMC_materials_mtoon of every selected material.

path.description: style-mutation:delete-path: dotted path into the glTF JSON chunk to delete.

expectFlip.description: style-mutation:*: rule id -> status the rule must reach, and it must differ from the baseline status.

expectUnchanged.description: style-mutation:*: rule ids whose status must equal the baseline.

envelope.description: report-fabricated: a report envelope {report, oracleHashes, exitCode} as the runner would produce, with fabricated contents.

applicabilityRecord.description: Required when applicable is false: who decided the visual dimension does not apply and why.

corpusApplicabilityRecord.description: Required when dimensions.corpus is inapplicable: who decided the corpus dimension does not apply and why, and what covers the parameter space instead.

corpus.description: Present when evidencePolicy.dimensions.corpus is required: one entry per style set the pack measures. The dimension passes only if every entry passes. A pack declaring the dimension required must supply at least one entry; enforced in validate_pack, since minItems would short-circuit schema validation before the more specific cross-reference error runs.

measurements.description: Written by style_lint.py corpus; supplies the per-family target vectors.

witnesses.description: swift-test packs: solved controls per family, keyed by the corpus and template hashes.

driver.description: swift-test packs: the replay driver. vrm-author-cli replays each witness through the shipped executable.

tolerance.description: Fraction of each target metric's own rule range width in this style's profile inside which a residual counts as reached. Must be greater than 0 and at most 1; enforced in validate_pack, since exclusiveMinimum/maximum are outside the schema subset validate_schema supports.

minEligibleFamilies.description: Floor below which the dimension is fail, never pass. Closes the vacuous pass at zero eligible families.
